validation.runnerAssertions: passed; 60 positions, 900 hidden-world draws, 5400 paired continuations; 0 unresolved thrown; 840 unique sampled allocations across positions

checkpoint.finding: Independent min-hand-pips discovery holdout replicates a model-specific preference for the ordinary single over spending a double when discarded pips, remaining hand size and number K of playable unknown tiles are matched. Direction strong for closed-branch-control and min-hand-pips continuation, not conclusive for fast-doubles. Immediate opponent action count differs frequently even with matched K; not a causal mechanism proof.
checkpoint.confidence: Exploratory position-level 95% normal intervals only; first eligible state/pair per deal; 15 hidden allocations per position with replacement (840 distinct out of 900 draws), uniform hidden worlds not conditioned on prior opponent decisions; branch-opening assumptions and block winner unresolved; post-action mobility is a mediator, not a causal control; no human-play generalization.
checkpoint.exactNext: On disjoint seeds 3900000..3999999 select at least 20 positions each for low/high K and low/high playable-set overlap, and log exact first opponent action/pass and full four-end geometry under both candidate moves; compare finish-first with position-cluster uncertainty, without conditioning away post-action mediators.
checkpoint.reproduction: node qosha-research/simulator/matched-k-strata-runner.js 3800000 3900000 60 15 min-hand-pips (V8 CommonJS executed; Node CLI not run).

data.selection: first eligible state and lexicographically first single-vs-one-double pair per deal; turns 4..24, no earlier pass; equal discarded pips, remaining hand size, and distinct playable unknown stone count K
data.limitations: Matched K is not matched tile identities or branch geometry. Uniform hidden allocations with replacement and no opponent-history conditioning; deterministic bots, assumed double opening, no block winner; post-action mobility is descriptive mediator, not causal adjustment. Position-level exploratory normal intervals are not pre-registered.
data.next: Repeat on disjoint seeds, require >=20 positions per K/overlap subgroup, then compare first-opponent reply identity and later finish while matching full four-end geometry where possible.

analysis.method: equal-weight per position; exploratory position-level normal intervals; strata descriptive, not causal; K=distinct playable unknown tiles after each candidate; overlap=shared playable tile identities
